news.headline: RTW Investments and Susquehanna disclose expanded stakes in uniQure
news.summary: RTW Investments reported a beneficial stake of about 3.94M shares (roughly 5.7%) and Susquehanna-affiliated entities disclosed a 3.34M-share (4.8%) position in fresh 13G filings. The filings point to continued institutional accumulation heading into the September AMT-130 data readout and Q3 BLA filing.

news.headline: Wall Street stays bullish on uniQure as shares rally into September data readout
news.summary: Stifel reiterated its Buy rating on uniQure with a $71 price target, citing the cleared FDA pathway for AMT-130 and the upcoming four-year data as the next major catalyst. Shares extended their multi-week rally amid a broader wave of sell-side optimism following the June FDA turnaround.

news.headline: uniQure says an FDA advisory committee for AMT-130 is likely and 'welcomes' the scrutiny
news.summary: Chief Medical Officer Walid Abi-Saab said the company believes an FDA advisory committee meeting for the Huntington's gene therapy is probable and that uniQure is preparing for it, even though the FDA has not formally requested one. The comments came amid broader 'regulatory jitters' across biopharma over unpredictable FDA advisory-meeting practices.

news.headline: Wolfe Research upgrades uniQure to Outperform, sees 'clear path to approval' for AMT-130
news.summary: Wolfe Research raised its rating to Outperform with a $65 price target, arguing the market is underpricing AMT-130's approval odds at under 50% when Wolfe models roughly 70%, with peak U.S. sales potential of about $2 billion. The upgrade followed the FDA's June agreement to accept three-year data as the primary basis for an accelerated-approval BLA.

news.headline: uniQure reports Q2 2026 results, confirms Q3 BLA timeline and cash runway into 2030
news.summary: Revenue rose to $5.8M and cash/investments stood at $810.3M as of June 30 after the recent raise, funding operations into 2030; net loss widened to $81.1M as commercial-readiness spending increased. Management confirmed the AMT-130 BLA remains on track for Q3 2026, said four-year Phase I/II data are expected in September, and detailed FDA confirmatory-study requirements (randomized standard-of-care control, Total Functional Capacity at 36 months as primary endpoint).

news.headline: Roche ends both of its Huntington's disease programs, clearing the field for uniQure
news.summary: Roche discontinued its two remaining Huntington's programs (Ionis-partnered tominersen and RG6496) after tominersen lowered mutant huntingtin and NfL but failed to slow clinical progression. The exit removes a major competitor just as uniQure's AMT-130 heads toward its Q3 BLA, strengthening its potential first-mover position in Huntington's gene therapy.

catalysts.label: Four-year AMT-130 data readout
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to present topline four-year safety and efficacy data covering all 24 patients from the first two dose cohorts (12 high-dose, 12 low-dose), plus additional three-year follow-up on three more high-dose patients. Analysts (e.g., Stifel) view this as the key near-term catalyst ahead of the BLA filing and any advisory committee.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 US BLA submission
catalysts.detail: uniQure remains on track to submit the BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease under the FDA accelerated-approval pathway in Q3 2026, based on the FDA's June agreement that three-year data can serve as primary evidence.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA marketing application (MAA)
catalysts.detail: Following a successful MHRA pre-submission meeting, uniQure plans a parallel UK Marketing Authorization Application for AMT-130 in Q3 2026 based on the same three-year data package, giving a second potential approval route.

catalysts.label: FDA advisory committee (AdCom) meeting
catalysts.detail: Management believes an FDA advisory committee review of AMT-130 is likely given it would be the first gene therapy for Huntington's disease, and says it is preparing for one, though the FDA has not formally confirmed a meeting or date.

catalysts.label: Confirmatory trial design finalized / initiation
catalysts.detail: The FDA wants a randomized, concurrent standard-of-care-controlled confirmatory study with Total Functional Capacity at 36 months as the primary endpoint; uniQure intends to begin this trial without delay following the BLA submission.

catalysts.label: Potential accelerated approval decision / epilepsy & Fabry updates
catalysts.detail: If the BLA is accepted with priority review, an FDA decision on what could be the first Huntington's gene therapy may land in 2027; uniQure also plans further clinical updates for its AMT-260 epilepsy and Fabry disease programs in H1 2027.

pulse: QURE remains in a catalyst-rich, still-binary setup: the June 2026 FDA reversal (accepting three-year AMT-130 data for an accelerated-approval BLA) triggered a wave of upgrades that continued through late July and August, with Wolfe (Outperform, $65 PT, ~70% approval odds) and Stifel (Buy, $71 PT) both turning more constructive, while institutional holders (RTW, Susquehanna) added to positions. The July 29 Q2 print confirmed cash runway into 2030 (~$810M) and reiterated the Q3 BLA/UK MAA timeline, and Roche's exit from Huntington's on July 9 removed the last major competitor. The next real test is the September four-year data readout, followed by the Q3 BLA filing and a likely-but-unconfirmed FDA advisory committee meeting — any data softness or a contentious AdCom remains the key risk given the stock's sharp run-up.
